ops-bot: Alert: hosted-infer-usw2 gateway p99 latency > SLO (5xx rate up). Incident id: I-17684
Elaine K: saw the alert. customers reporting increased 502s/timeouts. any quick checks?
Sam H: looking at ingress dashboard, 502s jump at 1768465400, spike aligns with prefetch queue backlog. :thinking:
Priya M: tracing shows a lot of missing spans around the gateway -> batcher hop. trace sampling looks low; link: https://observability/redwood/traces?q=trace%3A176846
Ravi P: api logs show repeated "handshake timeout" from connector (503) and upstream 504s. pulling logs now.
Elaine K: can we get a simple log query to correlate token auth failures vs 5xx?
Sam H: run this in logging:
```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.service="ingress-gateway" AND (jsonPayload.code=502 OR jsonPayload.code=504) AND timestamp>="2024-10-03T12:00:00Z"
```
Priya M: here's a quick bq-style metric query to check prefix cache evictions (suspected thrash):
```
fetch(redwood.metrics)
| filter(name=="kvcache_evictions" AND region=="usw2")
| sum by 1m
```
Ravi P: confirmed a kvcache eviction spike at 1768465385, followed by backpressure on batcher. prefetched requests doubled.
Elaine K: ops plan: 1) throttle prefetcher, 2) roll out canary to fallback model-variant with smaller kv footprints, 3) patch probe sampling to increase traces for this path.
Sam H: can we repro locally? try curl with same headers from support case:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "x-customer-id: 12345" \
  -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood-infer.com/v1/generate
```
Priya M: also useful: run synthetic load with the exact route and seq len to hit the long-tail:
```
python3 load.py --route /v1/generate --concurrency 20 --seq 1024 --duration 60s
```
Ravi P: I pushed a quick throttling rule to prefetcher (reduces backlog). watching metrics.
ops-bot: update: Incident I-17684 status=investigating, assigns=eng-sre, priority=high
Elaine K: customers on case #C-455 ask for ETA. say: investigating root cause, mitigation in progress, next update in 15m. :thumbsup:
Sam H: metrics already showing p99 latency coming down from 1.8s -> 1.1s since throttle at 1768465455.
Priya M: I'm scheduling a tracing increase for the gateway path to close trace gaps, will post queries when available.
Ravi P: will follow-up with a postmortem draft once we stabilize. adding potential action items: cache TTL tuning, prefetch rate limit, increased trace sampling for batcher hop.
Elaine K: thanks team — keep updates here. if customer impact continues after 10m escalate to oncall page.
Sam H: noted. monitoring window open until 1768465560.
